text:
Aisha: hi all, new hire here (Aisha). trying to access Redwood Console -> Admin > Feature Flags in prod but the option isn't visible on my account. can someone point me to who grants that?
Marco: welcome! :wave: new-hires usually need to be added to the "console-admins" okta group for prod flag writes. do you have your okta email?
Aisha: aisha@redwood.ai. i only see "Console (read)" under my profile. staging access exists.
Lara: @Marco fyi we tightened prod flag perms last quarter; temporary grants are only via infra with privilege hours logged. do we have a bulk onboarding exception?
infra-bot: IAM audit: aisha@redwood.ai -> groups: console-read, eng-oncall. Missing: console-admin (featureflag:modify). Recent changes: PROD_ADMIN_POLICY v3 applied 2025-01-08. See https://docs.redwood.ai/security/policies#prod-admin-policy
Aisha: i just need to toggle a rollout percentage for rollout_chat_assistant in prod for a 15-min smoke while we verify a telemetry fix. low risk, will revert.
Marco: quick question: can this be done via a temporary service account instead? we prefer granting user scopes for audit clarity but svc-account can be used if governance approves.
privsec-bot: For prod changes, privileged action workflow required. Steps: 1) create PRIV ticket with justification 2) sec review 3) infra grants temporary role (max 2h) 4) action and auto-revoke. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/privileged-actions
Aisha: i've opened PRIV-88: "temp prod flag toggle for rollout_chat_assistant (15m)". included risk assessment + rollback plan. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRIV-88
Lara: thanks. tagging @Marco for approval. if Marco approves, infra can do a 30m grant and we'll note in the incident log.
Marco: approved PRIV-88. I confirm low blast radius and monitoring is in place.
infra-bot: initiating grant: `grant-temp --user=aisha --role=console-admin --env=prod --ttl=00:30 --ticket=PRIV-88 --note="onboard smoke test"`
infra-bot: grant successful. audit_id=aud-9f834c. expires in 30m.
Aisha: toggled to 10% via Console UI and kicked off smoke runs. curl for reference: `curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/flags/rollout" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"rollout_chat_assistant","pct":10}'`
Aisha: tests look good. reverting to 0% now.
infra-bot: revoke scheduled at +30m. manual revoke executed by infra-bot at request of Lara. audit_id=aud-9f834c.
privsec-bot: review complete. entry added to privileged-action-log: PRIV-88. retention: 1y.
Lara: added note to onboarding doc: "Request prod flag access via PRIV ticket in first-week checklist" so new hires avoid ad-hoc delays.
Aisha: thanks everyone for the quick help :smile: made my first-week checklist item resolved.
